results.name: MINDHUNTER
results.overview: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

results.title: Potential Mindhunter Film
results.overview: Based on the famous Fincher series. Said to be released in the form of 3 2-hour movies.

results.title: Mindhunters
results.overview: Trainees in the FBI's psychological profiling program must put their training into practice when they discover a killer in their midst.  Based very loosely on Agatha Christie's And Then There Were None.

results.name: Violent Minds: Killers on Tape
results.overview: Renowned psychiatrist Dr. Al Carlisle's captivating inmate tapes with some of America’s most heinous killers helped him discover what drives a seemingly normal person to become obsessed with murder, exhibit violent tendencies and psychopathic behaviors.
